items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: I know who the reed section was. It was Bob Holmes

ctx.x: The reed section... I know who the reed section was. It was Bob Holmes, and the tenor player's name was Tramp -- he's dead now...Trent. Not Alfonso Trent. He was a tenor player. Anyway, let me see. There was Anderson... I don't remember who else was in the trumpets.
But there were two trumpets, though.
